name: Build Revenue
description: Find the fastest realistic revenue path, prioritize the 80/20 work, and prepare an execution plan.
purpose: Support business execution, offer intelligence, launch planning, positioning, and revenue modeling.

stages.name: Revenue Diagnosis
stages.description: Clarify the current circumstances, constraints, assets, and fastest viable revenue paths.

steps.label: Summarize current assets, constraints, and revenue channels from context.
Apply 80/20 prioritization to find the highest-leverage path.

stages.name: Risk and Capital Model
stages.description: Model effort, cash needs, risk, upside, and invalidation points.

steps.label: Estimate capital, time, and tool requirements.
Create base, conservative, and upside scenarios.
Define invalidation points and risk controls.

stages.name: Execution Plan
stages.description: Convert the selected path into tasks, owner actions, and approval gates.

steps.label: Build a task list for the selected revenue path.
Mark any spending, publishing, outreach, or production actions that require approval.
Define the first action to execute after approval.

userFacingBlurb: Find the fastest viable revenue path and turn it into an approved execution plan.
